    (* Bit 0: SIL-3 Safety Loop Interrupted

(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 1: CYCLIC EXECUTION PREPARATION & TIME BASE SYNCHRONIZATION
   ================================================================================================ *)
udiCycleCounter := udiCycleCounter + 1;

(* Compute physical scan period with boundary protection *)
IF tSampleCycle_DeltaT_ms > 0.05 AND tSampleCycle_DeltaT_ms < 10.0 THEN
    rDeltaTime_Sec := tSampleCycle_DeltaT_ms * 0.001;
ELSE
    rDeltaTime_Sec := 0.0005; (* Fallback to 500 microsecond deterministic base *)
END_IF;

(* Clear cycle transient status indicators *)
bMuzzleReleaseSignal := FALSE;
bQuenchProtectionTriggered := FALSE;
bInverterTrip_ActiveBlock := FALSE;
bInverterTrip_NextBlock := FALSE;

(* Total vehicle kinetic energy monitoring: E_k = 0.5 * m * v^2 [MJ] *)
rTotal_Kinetic_Energy_MJ := 0.5 * (rVEHICLE_MASS_NOMINAL_kg / 1000000.0) * (rObs_Vel_ms * rObs_Vel_ms);

(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) KINEMATIC SENSOR FUSION ENGINE
   ================================================================================================
   Evaluates heterogeneous sensor channels:
     Channel A: Laser Doppler Velocimeter (LDV)
     Channel B: 77 GHz FMCW Radar
     Channel C: Track Magnetic Grating Encoder
   Performs pairwise divergence cross-checks and bumpless degradation to 2oo2 or 1oo1 modes.
*)
(* Evaluate Channel A Health *)
IF (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh < -5.0) OR (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh > 1200.0) OR (rLaserDoppler_SignalQuality < 6.0) THEN
    udiChannelA_FaultCounter := udiChannelA_FaultCounter + 1;
    IF udiChannelA_FaultCounter > 6 THEN
        bChannelA_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF udiChannelA_FaultCounter > 0 THEN
        udiChannelA_FaultCounter := udiChannelA_FaultCounter - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF udiChannelA_FaultCounter = 0 THEN
        bChannelA_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Channel B Health *)
IF (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh < -5.0) OR (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh > 1200.0) OR (rRadar_SignalQuality < 0.25) THEN
    udiChannelB_FaultCounter := udiChannelB_FaultCounter + 1;
    IF udiChannelB_FaultCounter > 6 THEN
        bChannelB_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF udiChannelB_FaultCounter > 0 THEN
        udiChannelB_FaultCounter := udiChannelB_FaultCounter - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF udiChannelB_FaultCounter = 0 THEN
        bChannelB_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Channel C Health *)
IF (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh < -5.0) OR (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh > 1200.0) OR (rEncoder_SignalQuality < 0.30) THEN
    udiChannelC_FaultCounter := udiChannelC_FaultCounter + 1;
    IF udiChannelC_FaultCounter > 6 THEN
        bChannelC_Healthy := FALSE;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF udiChannelC_FaultCounter > 0 THEN
        udiChannelC_FaultCounter := udiChannelC_FaultCounter - 1;
    END_IF;
    IF udiChannelC_FaultCounter = 0 THEN
        bChannelC_Healthy := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Calculate Pairwise Channel Discrepancies *)
rDev_AB_kmh := ABS(rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh - rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh);
rDev_BC_kmh := ABS(rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh - rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh);
rDev_CA_kmh := ABS(rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh - rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh);

(* 2oo3 Voting Decision Matrix *)
IF bChannelA_Healthy AND bChannelB_Healthy AND bChannelC_Healthy THEN
    (* All 3 channels nominally healthy - execute median selection *)
    IF (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh >= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh AND rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh <= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh) OR
       (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh <= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh AND rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh >= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh) THEN
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh;
    ELSIF (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh >= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh AND rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh <= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh) OR
          (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh <= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh AND rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh >= rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh) THEN
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh;
    ELSE
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh;
    END_IF;
    bDegraded_Mode_Active := FALSE;
ELSIF bChannelA_Healthy AND bChannelB_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 2oo2 Mode: Channel C failed *)
    IF rDev_AB_kmh < rMAX_TMR_TOLERANCE_kmh THEN
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := 0.5 * (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh + rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh);
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    ELSE
        (* Divergence in 2oo2 - prioritize high-precision Laser Doppler *)
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh;
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
        udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded := udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded OR 16#00000001;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bChannelA_Healthy AND bChannelC_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 2oo2 Mode: Channel B failed *)
    IF rDev_CA_kmh < rMAX_TMR_TOLERANCE_kmh THEN
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := 0.5 * (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh + rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh);
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh;
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
        udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded := udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded OR 16#00000002;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bChannelB_Healthy AND bChannelC_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 2oo2 Mode: Channel A failed *)
    IF rDev_BC_kmh < rMAX_TMR_TOLERANCE_kmh THEN
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := 0.5 * (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh + rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh);
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh;
        bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
        udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded := udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded OR 16#00000004;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bChannelA_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo1 Mode: Sole remaining Laser Doppler channel *)
    rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh;
    bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00000010;
ELSIF bChannelB_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo1 Mode: Sole remaining Radar channel *)
    rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh;
    bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF bChannelC_Healthy THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo1 Mode: Sole remaining Magnetic Grating channel *)
    rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh;
    bDegraded_Mode_Active := TRUE;
    udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00000040;
ELSE
    (* COMPLETE SENSOR BLACKOUT: Trigger SIL-3 Category 0 Emergency Abort *)
    rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh := rObs_Vel_ms * 3.6; (* Hold last observer state *)
    udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency := udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency OR 16#00000100;
END_IF;

(* Convert voted velocity to SI units [m/s] *)
rTMR_Voted_Velocity_ms := rTMR_Voted_Velocity_kmh / 3.6;

(* Plausibility rate-of-change jerk check *)
IF ABS(rTMR_Voted_Velocity_ms - rPrev_Voted_Velocity_ms) / rDeltaTime_Sec > rMAX_ACCEL_RATE_PLAUSIBILITY_ms2 THEN
    udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00000200;
END_IF;
rPrev_Voted_Velocity_ms := rTMR_Voted_Velocity_ms;

(* Encode Sensor Health Telemetry Word *)
wSensorHealthBitmask := 16#0000;
IF bChannelA_Healthy THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0001; END_IF;
IF bChannelB_Healthy THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0002; END_IF;
IF bChannelC_Healthy THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0004; END_IF;
IF bDegraded_Mode_Active THEN wSensorHealthBitmask := wSensorHealthBitmask OR 16#0010; END_IF;
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 3: SUB-MILLIMETER KINEMATIC OBSERVER (STATE-SPACE KALMAN-LUENBERGER FILTER)
   ================================================================================================
   Discrete State Equation:
     x_hat[k+1] = A_d * x_hat[k] + B_d * u[k] + L_d * (y[k] - C_d * x_hat[k])
   Where:
     x_hat = [Position (m), Velocity (m/s), Acceleration (m/s2), DisturbanceForce (kN)]^T
     u     = [ThrustForce_kN, AeroForce_kN]^T
     y     = [Integrated_Laser_Pos_m, Integrated_Radar_Pos_m, Integrated_Grating_Pos_m]^T
*)
(* Numerical Integration of Position Measurements from Heterogeneous Sensors *)
rIntegrated_Laser_Pos_m   := rIntegrated_Laser_Pos_m + (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChA_kmh / 3.6) * rDeltaTime_Sec;
rIntegrated_Radar_Pos_m   := rIntegrated_Radar_Pos_m + (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChB_kmh / 3.6) * rDeltaTime_Sec;
rIntegrated_Grating_Pos_m := rIntegrated_Grating_Pos_m + (rVelocity_Vehicle_ChC_kmh / 3.6) * rDeltaTime_Sec;

(* Re-synchronize integrated sensor accumulators at physical block boundaries *)
IF rBlock_Entry_Position_mm > 0.0 AND ABS(rObs_Pos_m - (rBlock_Entry_Position_mm * 0.001)) < 2.5 THEN
    rIntegrated_Laser_Pos_m   := rBlock_Entry_Position_mm * 0.001;
    rIntegrated_Radar_Pos_m   := rBlock_Entry_Position_mm * 0.001;
    rIntegrated_Grating_Pos_m := rBlock_Entry_Position_mm * 0.001;
END_IF;

(* Compute Measurement Innovation Vector: e = y - C_d * x_hat *)
rTempCalc1 := rIntegrated_Laser_Pos_m   - (rMat_Cd_00 * rObs_Pos_m);
rTempCalc2 := rIntegrated_Radar_Pos_m   - (rMat_Cd_10 * rObs_Pos_m);
rTempCalc3 := rIntegrated_Grating_Pos_m - (rMat_Cd_20 * rObs_Pos_m);

(* Apply Health Weighting to Innovation Vector *)
IF NOT bChannelA_Healthy THEN rTempCalc1 := 0.0; END_IF;
IF NOT bChannelB_Healthy THEN rTempCalc2 := 0.0; END_IF;
IF NOT bChannelC_Healthy THEN rTempCalc3 := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Matrix State Propagation: x_next = A_d * x + B_d * u + L_d * e *)
rObs_Pos_m := (rMat_Ad_00 * rObs_Pos_m) +
              (rMat_Ad_01 * rObs_Vel_ms) +
              (rMat_Ad_02 * rObs_Accel_ms2) +
              (rMat_Ad_03 * rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN) +
              (rMat_Bd_00 * rCalculated_ThrustForce_kN) +
              (rMat_Bd_01 * rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN) +
              (rMat_Ld_00 * rTempCalc1) +
              (rMat_Ld_01 * rTempCalc2) +
              (rMat_Ld_02 * rTempCalc3);

rObs_Vel_ms := (rMat_Ad_10 * rObs_Pos_m) +
               (rMat_Ad_11 * rObs_Vel_ms) +
               (rMat_Ad_12 * rObs_Accel_ms2) +
               (rMat_Ad_13 * rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN) +
               (rMat_Bd_10 * rCalculated_ThrustForce_kN) +
               (rMat_Bd_11 * rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN) +
               (rMat_Ld_10 * rTempCalc1) +
               (rMat_Ld_11 * rTempCalc2) +
               (rMat_Ld_12 * rTempCalc3);

rObs_Accel_ms2 := (rMat_Ad_20 * rObs_Pos_m) +
                  (rMat_Ad_21 * rObs_Vel_ms) +
                  (rMat_Ad_22 * rObs_Accel_ms2) +
                  (rMat_Ad_23 * rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN) +
                  (rMat_Bd_20 * rCalculated_ThrustForce_kN) +
                  (rMat_Bd_21 * rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN) +
                  (rMat_Ld_20 * rTempCalc1) +
                  (rMat_Ld_21 * rTempCalc2) +
                  (rMat_Ld_22 * rTempCalc3);

rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN := (rMat_Ad_30 * rObs_Pos_m) +
                            (rMat_Ad_31 * rObs_Vel_ms) +
                            (rMat_Ad_32 * rObs_Accel_ms2) +
                            (rMat_Ad_33 * rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN) +
                            (rMat_Bd_30 * rCalculated_ThrustForce_kN) +
                            (rMat_Bd_31 * rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN) +
                            (rMat_Ld_30 * rTempCalc1) +
                            (rMat_Ld_31 * rTempCalc2) +
                            (rMat_Ld_32 * rTempCalc3);

(* Clamp Observer State to Physical Rails *)
IF rObs_Pos_m < 0.0 THEN rObs_Pos_m := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rObs_Vel_ms < 0.0 THEN rObs_Vel_ms := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Export Observer Quantities to Telemetry *)
rEstimated_AbsolutePosition_mm  := rObs_Pos_m * 1000.0;
rEstimated_AbsoluteVelocity_kmh := rObs_Vel_ms * 3.6;
rEstimated_AbsoluteAccel_ms2    := rObs_Accel_ms2;
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 4: DYNAMIC AERODYNAMIC NORMAL-FORCE NULLING & LEVITATION GAP REGULATOR
   ================================================================================================
   At velocities approaching 1,000 km/h (Mach > 0.8 in evacuated guide-way), compressible flow
   and ground-effect create extreme aerodynamic lift forces F_lift(v) tending to destabilize the
   levitation air gap. The controller executes active electromagnetic normal force injection
   via direct-axis current I_d bias to maintain nominal clearance (12.0 mm +/- 0.2 mm).
*)
(* Calculate Local Gas Dynamics in Partially Evacuated Tube *)
IF rTubeStaticPressure_kPa > 0.1 AND rTubeStaticPressure_kPa < 105.0 THEN
    rAirDensity_Ambient_kgm3 := (rTubeStaticPressure_kPa * 1000.0) / (287.05 * 293.15);
ELSE
    rAirDensity_Ambient_kgm3 := rVACUUM_AIR_DENSITY_kgm3;
END_IF;

(* Calculate Mach Number & Dynamic Pressure q = 0.5 * rho * v^2 *)
rMachNumber := rObs_Vel_ms / rSPEED_OF_SOUND_TUBE_ms;
rDynamicPressure_q_kPa := 0.5 * rAirDensity_Ambient_kgm3 * (rObs_Vel_ms * rObs_Vel_ms) * 0.001;

(* Aerodynamic Lift Model: F_lift = C_L * A_ref * q, where C_L increases with Mach near transonic *)
IF rMachNumber < 0.70 THEN
    rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN := (0.280 + (0.120 * rMachNumber)) * rVEHICLE_FRONTAL_AREA_m2 * rDynamicPressure_q_kPa;
ELSE
    (* Transonic compressibility amplification factor *)
    rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN := (0.364 + (0.450 * (rMachNumber - 0.70) * (rMachNumber - 0.70))) * rVEHICLE_FRONTAL_AREA_m2 * rDynamicPressure_q_kPa;
END_IF;

(* Levitation Air-Gap Error Computation *)
rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm := rNOMINAL_AIRGAP_SETPOINT_mm - rAirGap_Levitation_mm;

(* Safety Trip Checks on Air Gap Boundaries *)
IF rAirGap_Levitation_mm < rAIRGAP_MIN_TRIP_LIMIT_mm THEN
    udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency := udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency OR 16#00000004; (* Severe collapse trip *)
END_IF;
IF rAirGap_Levitation_mm > rAIRGAP_MAX_TRIP_LIMIT_mm THEN
    udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency := udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency OR 16#00000008; (* Severe flyaway trip *)
END_IF;

(* Closed-Loop PID Air-Gap Regulator with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
rTempCalc1 := (rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm * 0.001); (* Error in meters *)

(* Proportional Term *)
rTempCalc2 := rAirGap_Regulator_P_Gain * rTempCalc1;

(* Integral Term with Saturation Bounds *)
rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator := rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator + (rAirGap_Regulator_I_Gain * rTempCalc1 * rDeltaTime_Sec);
IF rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator > 1.80 THEN
    rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator := 1.80;
ELSIF rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator < -1.80 THEN
    rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator := -1.80;
END_IF;

(* Derivative Term on Error Slope *)
rTempCalc3 := rAirGap_Regulator_D_Gain * ((rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm - rAirGap_Error_Previous_mm) * 0.001) / rDeltaTime_Sec;
rAirGap_Error_Previous_mm := rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm;

(* Feedforward Lift Nulling Injection: Delta_Id_ff = -F_aero / NormalForceSensitivity *)
rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA := (rTempCalc2 + rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator + rTempCalc3) - (rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN / rNORMAL_FORCE_COEFF_kN_per_kA);

(* Clamp Direct-Axis Bias to Thermal / Converter Limits [-2.5 kA .. +2.0 kA] *)
IF rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA > 2.00 THEN
    rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA := 2.00;
ELSIF rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA < -2.50 THEN
    rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA := -2.50;
END_IF;
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST APPROXIMATION
   ================================================================================================
   Solves optimal current increments [Delta_I_d, Delta_I_q] over receding horizon:
     min J = 0.5 * Delta_U^T * H * Delta_U + g^T * Delta_U
   Analytical unconstrained minimum: Delta_U* = -H^(-1) * g
   Subjected to Euclidean projection onto box and rate constraints.
*)
(* Trajectory Error Evaluation *)
rMPC_Accel_Error_ms2 := rMPC_TARGET_ACCEL_ms2 - rObs_Accel_ms2;
rMPC_Velocity_Error_ms := (rTarget_LaunchVelocity_kmh / 3.6) - rObs_Vel_ms;

(* Update Linear Gradient Vector g based on tracking errors and air-gap deviation *)
rMPC_Gradient_0 := -1.0 * (rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm * 15.0) + (rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA * 8.5);
rMPC_Gradient_1 := -1.0 * (rMPC_Accel_Error_ms2 * 18.5) - (rMPC_Velocity_Error_ms * 0.45);

(* 2x2 Matrix Inversion for Quadratic Hessian H *)
rDetH := (rMPC_Hessian_00 * rMPC_Hessian_11) - (rMPC_Hessian_01 * rMPC_Hessian_10);

IF ABS(rDetH) > 0.001 THEN
    rInvH_00 :=  rMPC_Hessian_11 / rDetH;
    rInvH_01 := -rMPC_Hessian_01 / rDetH;
    rInvH_10 := -rMPC_Hessian_10 / rDetH;
    rInvH_11 :=  rMPC_Hessian_00 / rDetH;

    (* Analytical Gradient Projection Step: Delta_U = -H_inv * g *)
    rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt := -1.0 * ((rInvH_00 * rMPC_Gradient_0) + (rInvH_01 * rMPC_Gradient_1));
    rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt := -1.0 * ((rInvH_10 * rMPC_Gradient_0) + (rInvH_11 * rMPC_Gradient_1));
ELSE
    (* Fallback Steepest Descent step in case of ill-conditioned Hessian *)
    rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt := -0.001 * rMPC_Gradient_0;
    rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt := -0.001 * rMPC_Gradient_1;
END_IF;

(* Rate Constraint Slew Rate Limiting *)
IF rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt > rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA THEN
    rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt := rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA;
ELSIF rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt < -rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA THEN
    rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt := -rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA;
END_IF;

IF rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt > rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA THEN
    rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt := rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA;
ELSIF rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt < -rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA THEN
    rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt := -rMPC_MAX_DELTA_I_kA;
END_IF;

(* Accumulate Optimal Commanded Currents *)
IF iMainState = 30 THEN (* Running in Trajectory Acceleration *)
    rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA    := rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA + rMPC_Delta_Id_Opt;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA + rMPC_Delta_Iq_Opt;
ELSIF iMainState = 60 THEN (* Emergency Regenerative Braking *)
    rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA    := rCompensating_Id_Bias_kA;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := -rRegenBrake_Iq_Cmd_kA;
ELSIF iMainState = 20 THEN (* Alignment and Pre-flux *)
    rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA    := 0.50;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := 0.25;
ELSE
    rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA    := 0.0;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Boundary Saturation for Motor Peak Thermal Limits *)
IF rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA > (rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA * rThermal_Derate_Factor) THEN
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA * rThermal_Derate_Factor;
ELSIF rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA < -(rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA * rThermal_Derate_Factor) THEN
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := -(rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA * rThermal_Derate_Factor);
END_IF;
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 6: MULTI-SEGMENT STATOR BLOCK HIGH-SPEED HANDOVER CONTROLLER
   ================================================================================================
   Handles spatial tracking and seamless power transfer across 120-meter stator segments.
   At 1,000 km/h (277.8 m/s), the 25-meter overlap zone is traversed in exactly 90 milliseconds.
   The smooth quintic S-curve crossfader eliminates inverter DC-link voltage surges and thrust dip:
     S(sigma) = 10 * sigma^3 - 15 * sigma^4 + 6 * sigma^5
*)
(* Calculate Position Relative to Current Active Block Ingress *)
IF rBlock_Length_m > 10.0 THEN
    rBlock_Relative_Position_m := rObs_Pos_m - (rBlock_Entry_Position_mm * 0.001);
ELSE
    rBlock_Relative_Position_m := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Determine Handover Zone Threshold *)
rHandover_Zone_Start_m := rBlock_Length_m - rHandover_Zone_Length_m;

IF (rBlock_Relative_Position_m >= rHandover_Zone_Start_m) AND (rBlock_Relative_Position_m <= rBlock_Length_m) THEN
    bHandoverInProgress := TRUE;
    
    (* Normalized Handover Parameter sigma in [0.0, 1.0] *)
    IF rHandover_Zone_Length_m > 0.1 THEN
        rHandover_Normalized_Sigma := (rBlock_Relative_Position_m - rHandover_Zone_Start_m) / rHandover_Zone_Length_m;
    ELSE
        rHandover_Normalized_Sigma := 1.0;
    END_IF;

    IF rHandover_Normalized_Sigma < 0.0 THEN rHandover_Normalized_Sigma := 0.0; END_IF;
    IF rHandover_Normalized_Sigma > 1.0 THEN rHandover_Normalized_Sigma := 1.0; END_IF;

    (* Quintic Polynomial S-Curve Weighting Function (C2 Continuous) *)
    rWeight_NextBlock := (10.0 * (rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma)) -
                         (15.0 * (rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma)) +
                         (6.0  * (rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma * rHandover_Normalized_Sigma));
    
    rWeight_ActiveBlock := 1.0 - rWeight_NextBlock;
    rHandover_Progress_Pct := rWeight_NextBlock * 100.0;

    (* Verify Next Block Inverter Readiness *)
    IF NOT bInverterReady_NextBlock THEN
        (* Handover failure interlock - abort to dynamic braking *)
        udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00001000;
    END_IF;

ELSIF rBlock_Relative_Position_m > rBlock_Length_m THEN
    (* Handover Complete: Increment Segment Pointers and Reset Weights *)
    bHandoverInProgress := FALSE;
    rHandover_Progress_Pct := 100.0;
    rWeight_ActiveBlock := 1.0;
    rWeight_NextBlock := 0.0;
    iActive_Stator_Segment := iActive_Stator_Segment + 1;
    iNext_Stator_Segment := iActive_Stator_Segment + 1;
ELSE
    (* Steady-State Single-Block Conduction *)
    bHandoverInProgress := FALSE;
    rHandover_Progress_Pct := 0.0;
    rWeight_ActiveBlock := 1.0;
    rWeight_NextBlock := 0.0;
END_IF;
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 7: INVERTER FIELD-ORIENTED CONTROL (FOC) & ROTATIONAL d-q DECOUPLING
   ================================================================================================
   Implements high-speed Clarke/Park transformations, back-EMF decoupling voltage generation,
   and closed-loop PI current control with anti-windup clamping.
*)
(* Electrical Frequency & Rotor Flux Spatial Phase Calculation *)
rElectrical_AngularVelocity_w_rads := (3.14159265 / rPOLE_PITCH_TAU_m) * rObs_Vel_ms;
rInverter_ElectricalFreq_Hz := rElectrical_AngularVelocity_w_rads / (2.0 * 3.14159265);

(* Continuous Integration of Electrical Rotor Flux Phase Angle theta_e *)
rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad := rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad + (rElectrical_AngularVelocity_w_rads * rDeltaTime_Sec);
WHILE rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad >= (2.0 * 3.14159265) DO
    rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad := rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad - (2.0 * 3.14159265);
END_WHILE;
WHILE rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad < 0.0 DO
    rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad := rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad + (2.0 * 3.14159265);
END_WHILE;

rSin_Theta := SIN(rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad);
rCos_Theta := COS(rElectrical_Angle_Theta_rad);

(* Clarke Transformation (3-phase stationary ABC -> 2-phase stationary Alpha-Beta) *)
rCurrent_Alpha_kA := rCurrent_PhaseA_LSM_kA;
rCurrent_Beta_kA  := (0.577350269) * (rCurrent_PhaseB_LSM_kA - rCurrent_PhaseC_LSM_kA);

(* Park Transformation (Stationary Alpha-Beta -> Synchronous Rotating d-q) *)
rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA :=  (rCurrent_Alpha_kA * rCos_Theta) + (rCurrent_Beta_kA * rSin_Theta);
rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA   := -(rCurrent_Alpha_kA * rSin_Theta) + (rCurrent_Beta_kA * rCos_Theta);

(* d-q Cross-Coupling Decoupling Voltage Terms:
     V_d_comp = -omega_e * L_q * I_q
     V_q_comp = +omega_e * (L_d * I_d + Psi_f) *)
rDecoupling_Vd_Comp_kV := -1.0 * (rElectrical_AngularVelocity_w_rads * rINDUCTANCE_Lq_Henry * rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA);
rDecoupling_Vq_Comp_kV :=  1.0 * (rElectrical_AngularVelocity_w_rads * ((rINDUCTANCE_Ld_Henry * rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA) + rHTS_FLUX_LINKAGE_Psi_Wb * 0.001));

(* Direct-Axis PI Current Controller *)
rTempCalc1 := rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA - rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA; (* Error in kA *)
rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV := rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV + (rPI_Direct_Ki * rTempCalc1 * rDeltaTime_Sec);

(* Anti-Windup Limits on Direct-Axis Integrator *)
IF rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV > 3.0 THEN rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV := 3.0; END_IF;
IF rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV < -3.0 THEN rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV := -3.0; END_IF;

rUnsaturated_Vd_kV := (rPI_Direct_Kp * rTempCalc1) + rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV + rDecoupling_Vd_Comp_kV;

(* Quadrature-Axis PI Current Controller *)
rTempCalc2 := rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA - rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA; (* Error in kA *)
rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV := rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV + (rPI_Quad_Ki * rTempCalc2 * rDeltaTime_Sec);

(* Anti-Windup Limits on Quadrature-Axis Integrator *)
IF rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV > 4.5 THEN rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV := 4.5; END_IF;
IF rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV < -4.5 THEN rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV := -4.5; END_IF;

rUnsaturated_Vq_kV := (rPI_Quad_Kp * rTempCalc2) + rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV + rDecoupling_Vq_Comp_kV;

(* Vector Voltage Limiting & Modulation Index Synthesizer *)
rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV := SQRT((rUnsaturated_Vd_kV * rUnsaturated_Vd_kV) + (rUnsaturated_Vq_kV * rUnsaturated_Vq_kV));

IF rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV > rMAX_VOLTAGE_INVERTER_kV AND rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV > 0.01 THEN
    (* Over-modulation saturation - scale voltage vector proportionally *)
    rInverter_DirectAxisVoltage_kV     := (rUnsaturated_Vd_kV / rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV) * rMAX_VOLTAGE_INVERTER_kV;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisVoltage_kV := (rUnsaturated_Vq_kV / rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV) * rMAX_VOLTAGE_INVERTER_kV;
    rModulationIndex_ActiveInverter    := 1.15;
ELSE
    rInverter_DirectAxisVoltage_kV     := rUnsaturated_Vd_kV;
    rInverter_QuadratureAxisVoltage_kV := rUnsaturated_Vq_kV;
    IF rDCBus_Voltage_kV > 0.5 THEN
        rModulationIndex_ActiveInverter := (rVoltage_Magnitude_Total_kV * 1.4142) / (rDCBus_Voltage_kV * 0.612);
    ELSE
        rModulationIndex_ActiveInverter := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Developed Electrodynamic Force Equations *)
rCalculated_ThrustForce_kN := (1.5 * (3.14159265 / rPOLE_PITCH_TAU_m) * rHTS_FLUX_LINKAGE_Psi_Wb * rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA) +
                              (0.75 * (3.14159265 / rPOLE_PITCH_TAU_m) * (rINDUCTANCE_Ld_Henry - rINDUCTANCE_Lq_Henry) * rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA * rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA);

rCalculated_NormalForce_kN := (rNORMAL_FORCE_COEFF_kN_per_kA * rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA) - rEstimated_Aerodynamic_Lift_kN;

(* Instantaneous Electrical Active and Reactive Power Computation *)
rInverter_ActivePower_MW   := 1.5 * ((rInverter_DirectAxisVoltage_kV * rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA) + (rInverter_QuadratureAxisVoltage_kV * rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA));
rInverter_ReactivePower_MVAR := 1.5 * ((rInverter_QuadratureAxisVoltage_kV * rCurrent_Direct_Id_kA) - (rInverter_DirectAxisVoltage_kV * rCurrent_Quad_Iq_kA));
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 8: FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) - MULTI-STAGE ACCELERATOR SEQUENCE
   ================================================================================================
   Manages the deterministic transition across operational phases:
     0:  COLD INITIALIZATION
     10: STANDBY PRELAUNCH
     20: ALIGNMENT & LEVITATION LOCK
     30: TRAJECTORY ACCELERATION
     40: BLOCK HANDOVER EXECUTION
     50: COAST & TERMINAL MUZZLE RELEASE
     60: CONTROLLED REGENERATIVE BRAKING
     99: SIL-3 EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN
*)
(* Detect State Transition Edge *)
IF iMainState <> iPreviousState THEN
    bStateFirstScan := TRUE;
    iPreviousState := iMainState;
ELSE
    bStateFirstScan := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Evaluate SIL-3 Critical Interlock Override *)
IF NOT bSafetyLoopClosed OR bManualAbort_Command OR (udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency <> 0) THEN
    iMainState := 99; (* Immediate jump to Category 0 Emergency Trip *)
END_IF;

CASE iMainState OF
    0: (* STATE_COLD_INITIALIZATION *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDecelActive := FALSE;
        rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec := 0.0;
        
        (* Reset Observers and Integrators *)
        rObs_Pos_m := 0.0;
        rObs_Vel_ms := 0.0;
        rObs_Accel_ms2 := 0.0;
        rObs_DisturbanceForce_kN := 0.0;
        rIntegrated_Laser_Pos_m := 0.0;
        rIntegrated_Radar_Pos_m := 0.0;
        rIntegrated_Grating_Pos_m := 0.0;
        rPI_Direct_Integrator_kV := 0.0;
        rPI_Quad_Integrator_kV := 0.0;
        rAirGap_Integral_Accumulator := 0.0;
        
        (* Verify DC Bus and Cryogenic Preconditions *)
        IF bSafetyLoopClosed AND (rDCBus_Voltage_kV >= rMIN_DC_BUS_VOLTAGE_kV) AND bCryoSystem_Operational THEN
            iMainState := 10;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_STANDBY_PRELAUNCH *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDecelActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Check All Subsystem Readies for Launch Arming *)
        IF bMasterEnable AND bTrackClearance_Verified AND bVacuumTube_PressureOK AND
           bInverterReady_ActiveBlock AND (rCryo_MagnetTemperature_degC < -196.0) THEN
            iMainState := 20;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_ALIGNMENT_LEVITATION *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Establish initial flux field and lock levitation air-gap *)
        IF ABS(rDynamic_AirGap_Error_mm) < 0.50 THEN
            (* Levitation stabilized at nominal 12.0 mm setpoint - initiate trajectory *)
            iMainState := 30;
            rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_TRAJECTORY_ACCEL *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaunchActive := TRUE;
        bEmergencyDecelActive := FALSE;
        rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec := rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec + rDeltaTime_Sec;

        (* Check for Target Muzzle Velocity Achievement (1,000 km/h) *)
        IF rEstimated_AbsoluteVelocity_kmh >= rTarget_LaunchVelocity_kmh THEN
            iMainState := 50;
        END_IF;

        (* Check for Intermediate Stator Handover Trigger *)
        IF bHandoverInProgress THEN
            iMainState := 40;
        END_IF;

        (* Check for Category 1 Abort Trigger *)
        IF udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort <> 0 THEN
            iMainState := 60;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_BLOCK_HANDOVER_EXEC *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaunchActive := TRUE;
        rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec := rLaunchElapsedTime_Sec + rDeltaTime_Sec;
        rHandoverElapsedTime_Sec := rHandoverElapsedTime_Sec + rDeltaTime_Sec;

        (* Check for Handover Completion *)
        IF NOT bHandoverInProgress THEN
            rHandoverElapsedTime_Sec := 0.0;
            iMainState := 30; (* Return to primary acceleration *)
        END_IF;

        (* Handover Timeout Protection (> 250 milliseconds in overlap zone) *)
        IF rHandoverElapsedTime_Sec > 0.250 THEN
            udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00002000;
            iMainState := 60;
        END_IF;

        IF udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort <> 0 THEN
            iMainState := 60;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_COAST_TERMINAL_RELEASE *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        bMuzzleReleaseSignal := TRUE; (* Trigger electromagnetic separation latch *)

        (* Ramp Down Inverter Currents Smoothly *)
        rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;
        rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;

        IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iMainState := 0; (* Return to cold init on sequence completion *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_REGENERATIVE_BRAKE *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDecelActive := TRUE;

        (* Apply Maximum Controlled Dynamic Regenerative Retardation *)
        rRegenBrake_Iq_Cmd_kA := (rAbort_TargetDecel_ms2 * rVEHICLE_MASS_NOMINAL_kg * 0.001) / rTHRUST_FORCE_COEFF_kN_per_kA;
        IF rRegenBrake_Iq_Cmd_kA > rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA THEN
            rRegenBrake_Iq_Cmd_kA := rMAX_STATOR_CURRENT_RMS_kA;
        END_IF;

        (* If Vehicle Stopped, De-energize completely *)
        IF rObs_Vel_ms < 0.25 THEN
            rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;
            rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;
            bEmergencyDecelActive := FALSE;
            IF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
                iMainState := 0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_SHUTDOWN (SIL-3 Category 0) *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bLaunchActive := FALSE;
        bEmergencyDecelActive := FALSE;
        bInverterTrip_ActiveBlock := TRUE;
        bInverterTrip_NextBlock := TRUE;
        
        (* Invalidate Voltage Commands *)
        rInverter_DirectAxisVoltage_kV := 0.0;
        rInverter_QuadratureAxisVoltage_kV := 0.0;
        rInverter_DirectAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;
        rInverter_QuadratureAxisCurrent_kA := 0.0;

        (* Quench Protection Activation if Magnet Cryo Compromised *)
        IF rCryo_MagnetTemperature_degC > -180.0 THEN
            bQuenchProtectionTriggered := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        (* Latch until master reset and safety loop closure *)
        IF bSafetyLoopClosed AND NOT bManualAbort_Command AND (udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency = 0) AND NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iMainState := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;
(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 9: THERMAL MONITORING & GRACEFUL POWER DERATING ENGINE
   ================================================================================================
   Monitors high-power inverter IGBT junction temperature and stator core thermal sensors.
   Enforces graceful continuous current derating between 110 deg C and 140 deg C.
*)
IF (rInverter_IGBT_Temperature_degC > 110.0) OR (rStator_CoreTemperature_degC > 120.0) THEN
    bPower_Derate_Enforced := TRUE;
    
    (* Linear Derating Profile: 100% capacity at 110 C down to 50% capacity at 140 C *)
    IF rInverter_IGBT_Temperature_degC > 110.0 THEN
        rThermal_Derate_Factor := 1.0 - (0.50 * ((rInverter_IGBT_Temperature_degC - 110.0) / 30.0));
    ELSE
        rThermal_Derate_Factor := 1.0 - (0.50 * ((rStator_CoreTemperature_degC - 120.0) / 25.0));
    END_IF;

    IF rThermal_Derate_Factor < 0.50 THEN
        rThermal_Derate_Factor := 0.50;
    END_IF;
    udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded := udiFaultRegister_Cat2_Degraded OR 16#00000100;
ELSE
    bPower_Derate_Enforced := FALSE;
    rThermal_Derate_Factor := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* Critical Core Overtemperature Trip (> 145 deg C) *)
IF (rStator_CoreTemperature_degC > 145.0) OR (rInverter_IGBT_Temperature_degC > 145.0) THEN
    udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency := udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency OR 16#00000040;
END_IF;

(* DC Intermediate Bus Voltage Boundary Protection *)
IF rDCBus_Voltage_kV > rMAX_DC_BUS_VOLTAGE_kV THEN
    udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency := udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF (rDCBus_Voltage_kV < rMIN_DC_BUS_VOLTAGE_kV) AND (iMainState >= 20) THEN
    udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort := udiFaultRegister_Cat1_FastAbort OR 16#00000400;
END_IF;

(* Cryogenic Quench Anticipation Protection *)
IF rCryo_MagnetTemperature_degC > -185.0 THEN
    udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency := udiFaultRegister_Cat0_Emergency OR 16#00000010;
END_IF;

(* ================================================================================================
   SECTION 10: ALARM HIERARCHY, STATUS WORD & DIAGNOSTIC SYNTHESIS
   ================================================================================================
   Packs multi-tier diagnostic health telemetry into standardized industrial Modbus/Profinet words.
*)
(* Pack Machine Status Word *)
wLauncherStatusWord := 16#0000;
